name: omnilab/copernicus
description: Omnilab Copernicus: the products of the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem's STAC catalogue - Sentinel-1, -2, -3, -5P, Landsat, MODIS, the Copernicus DEM and services - searched by collection, point or box, period and cloud cover, page by page, with their footprints, properties, assets and thumbnails; open without an account (downloading the assets needs a CDSE token and stays with the application).
